pages.text: $(li)**An attached machine is not working:$(br)no recipe can run**:$(br)every machine on the vat must work, even the ones the current recipe does not use.
An industrial mixer needs rotation, electrode holders need power from their top face, and every other machine must be running too.$(br)Fix it or remove it.

$(li)$(item)No recipe matches: check size, vat type and machines in JEI$(): the inputs fit no recipe for this vat. Recipes can ask for a minimum vat size (up to 3x3), a vat type (steel, cast iron or firebrick-lined) and particular machines. JEI shows all of these on each recipe.

$(li)$(item)Not hot enough for this recipe$(): put fireboxes or blaze burners under the vat, and feed them.$(li)$(item)Pressure too low for this recipe$(): the recipe needs a pressure the vat does not have. A compressor on the vat changes its pressure; JEI shows the pressure each recipe needs.
Remember that pipes can only fill the vat's inputs and drain its outputs. The arc furnace is a firebrick-lined vat of at least 3x3 with three powered electrode holders on top.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
